$comment: D4 lifecycle scenarios: results, rematch, queue promotion, bounded inactivity, empty reap, owner loss.

scenarios.title: Results display retained 120s without user action, then remaining viewers return to the world

notes: no idle heartbeat counts as user action
session may then reap if empty

scenarios.title: All remaining loaded seated riders ready with >= 2 starts a fresh match identity

notes: Rematch is readiness displayed within results, not another server phase
disconnected u3 has no vote; reconnect during countdown cannot join the locked roster

scenarios.title: Free slot at results/lobby is offered FIFO with a 30s accept window

notes: offer timeout returns q1 to queue head? no: expired offer falls through to the next rider

scenarios.title: Nonready seated player is released after 120s without user action

notes: disconnected users follow reconnect grace instead of this timer

scenarios.title: Session stops within 60s after the last reconnect grace expires; spectators alone never keep it alive

notes: spectators receive an idle summary and are detached at reap

scenarios.title: Owner shutdown/restart aborts transient races with no invented winner

notes: work stops and session/leases are invalidated
clients see an abort banner and release the activity view locally
after room rejoin a fresh lobby is offered
successor session uses a fresh identity with no restored in-flight physics
